sequenceDiagram
autonumber 10 5
actor User
participant UI@{ "type": "boundary" }
participant Controller@{ "type": "control" }
participant Record@{ "type": "entity" }
participant DB@{ "type": "database" }
participant Cache@{ "type": "collections" }
participant Queue@{ "type": "queue" }
User->>UI: Submit order
UI->>+Controller: validate and store
loop Every item
  Controller->>Record: Validate item
  alt Invalid input
    Record-->>Controller: errors
  else Accepted
    Controller->>DB: Store record
    DB-->>Controller: record ID
  end
end
Controller->>Cache: Invalidate view
Controller-)Queue: Notify subscribers
Controller-->>-UI: Result
Note over User,UI: The result remains editable
